UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Publicly non-PII user profile metadata for an authenticated Anu workspace user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the workspace sidebar.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the authenticated user's email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when private info was last updated.

clientCreatedAt.description: Client creation epoch milliseconds for ordering.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client update epoch milliseconds for ordering.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user profile document for each authenticated workspace user.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection storing private user email information at docId 'info'.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Private chat sessions owned by the user.
